column2: Hmph! None of your business. If you get in our way, we'll simply kill you!
What is happening in the Empire...?
Our army won't fall to one man!
Is the Empire trying to take back its old territory...?
You could never grasp our Emperor's aims. Obey us quietly, or die!
What on earth should I do...?
Wahahaha! Glory to the great Empire!
What is the Empire after, tormenting innocent people like this?!
Nothing surpasses our great cause. Beg for mercy now and we may spare you... Wahahaha!
As if I'd... beg the likes of you...
Damn... Against the Empire, there's no end to it...
Resisting us is futile!
The Crimson Moon King is with us! Wahahaha!
You'd torment innocent people just to take back your old territory?!
No one can stop our march!
Even if I win this fight, I can't stop them... Damn it!
I fight for the Emperor!
Even monsters have joined the Imperial Army? Will you repeat the tragedy of the Crimson Moon King?!
Fused Troop
Exactly! No one can stop us, for we follow the Emperor's will!
I never thought this could happen... But I won't give up...
Gwahahaha! Foolish humans! Now you know our power!!
Even monsters like this are appearing...
Chaos Jelly
Gyurugyuruu...
If you keep attacking people, I'll just have to defeat you...
It's over...
Dead Plant
Hyuruhyuru...
I won't forgive cowards like you!
Thief
You wanna get in our way? Hah! This'll be fun!
All talk...
Hahaha! Serves you right!
If this thing attacked a ship, it wouldn't stand a chance...{wait}{clear}For the people of Bremes, I'll defeat you!
The harbor should be safe now.
Sea Dragon
Gugyaaah~!
If only you'd lived quietly in the sea...
The people of Bremes should be safe now.
Gugigyaaah~!
It can't be helped if it runs wild on the highway... I'll have to get rid of it.
That should do it.
Venom
Hsss hsss hsss...
If only you'd lived quietly...
It's over... The village should be safe now.
Roc
Kwaaaaah!
Millipede
Gishigishigishigishi...
Undead after all... Wretched creatures... I'll send you back to hell.
Return to hell...
Skull Knight
HUMANS... NOT NEEDED... KAKAKAKAKA...!
That wailing... It was a banshee after all...
A wretched creature...
Banshee
Hihihihihi...
Are you the ones attacking the village?
Burglar
What the hell? You came to beat us or something?{wait}{clear}Hah! No way you can beat us! Get him!!
There must be plenty more of these guys...
Hahaha! What can you do on your own?!
Demons... but why...
Ribezal
Fuhahaha... Our world is finally about to be born.{wait}{clear}You pests will have to disappear!
So they've finally shown themselves...
Humans are no match for us! Fuhahahaha...!
